No brand logo, model plate, screen, ports, or power label is visible or legible anywhere in the frame.

risks.risk: Brand cannot be confirmed; LG badge or back label not visible.

Photo of the back label showing brand, model number, and screen size.
Photo of the open back/transformer area showing the stated damage.
Photo confirming power-on attempt (or lack of any response) if possible.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as an old CRT television, and the seller discloses it is non-functional (blown transformer); with brand, size, and damage extent unverifiable from this dark photo, it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, unbranded-size-unconfirmed CRT TV.
